evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# DSH HUD · 独立组件中心

**规范仓库：** `OttoBlues/dsh-hud-plugin`。DSH 安装插件名保持 `@local/dsh-hud`。

- HUD 拥有自己的左侧导航入口和独立组件管理主界面，而非 DSH 原生插件管理页里的子标签。
- 从公开组件索引读取已安装与未安装组件，可按 `released` 或 `unstable` 已登记版本手动安装和更新。
- 版本和 SHA-256 校验在 Host 侧完成，使用 DSH 官方 `pluginManager.installBundle`；不需要 GitHub Token 和自托管 Actions Runner。
- 自动更新默认关闭，试验版订阅与自动试验版需要独立授权；窗口内 HUD 预览默认关闭。
- 历史 V0.4.0 曾出现自更新宿主异常，V0.4.1 引入 Host 生命周期保护。

**已发布：** Unstable V0.5.8（修复 v0.5.7 窗口启动超时，U058 实机待验收）；Released 为空。用户截图确认已在 Windows Desktop 安装 V0.4.1。

**历史发布：** V0.4.2 完成仓库更名与本地 Runner 退役。后续 v0.5.x 已增加 DSH 组件中心、只读公开更新检查与独立 HUD 候选。安装仍须人工确认，不能将 CI 视为 Desktop 无崩溃验收。

## V0.5.0 HUD 主界面试验版

- 加入可交互的全帧 HUD 工作区、真实会话状态和 HUD/DSH 双向切换入口，默认仍使用 DSH。
- HUD 页可以进入组件中心或返回 DSH 会话。聊天发送与审批仍使用原生 DSH，防止绕过权限。
- 本版本已发布在 Unstable，待 U05 实机验收；不进入 Released。参见 `docs/HUD-WORKSPACE-V050.md`。

## V0.5.1 设计候选（Unstable，待验收）

- 全帧 HUD 与组件中心采用共用的线框切角组件系统，细网格、局部扫描线、暗蓝/青色高亮。
- 组件中心提供手动检查公开通道并反馈失败原因的控制按钮，区别于安装按钮。
- 视效强度与排版结构在用户体验 Unstable 后确认；保留安全返回原生 DSH 的入口。

## V0.5.2 修正版（Unstable，待用户验收）

- HUD 舱体取消非等比 SVG 描边，改用固定像素切角、双层实体仪表面板和少量统一状态线。
- 组件管理页恢复原生 DSH 主题，轻量青蓝品牌识别，仅 HUD 工作区保持深色驾驶舱。
- “检查更新”、安装包验证和 HUD / DSH 主界面切换保持原功能；用户按 U052 逐项确认视觉后才定稿。

## V0.5.3 试验候选（Unstable，待 U053）

- HUD 整体纯色：舱体 `#071522`、信息面板 `#142b3a`、统一边线 `#6dcbd2`；无渐变、阴影光效和浮动装饰。
- 组件中心的手动检查增加 Host 28s 扫描限时、配置写入限时，UI 超过 45s 显示超时并允许重试；后台检查时间可见。
- 移除原 DSH 页面上的浮动 HUD 入口，只允许通过 HUD 组件中心主动切换；保留 DSH 原生组件中心配色、插件隔离与回退按钮。

## V0.5.4 Host 更新请求可靠性修复（Unstable）

如果组件中心检查版本始终“排队等待 Host”，V0.5.4 为未能写入 DSH 配置编辑器的请求提供同 nonce 重试、运行时获取 ConfigEditor 和相关警告日志。自动化回归已覆盖编辑器初始不可用与写入失败后的恢复，实际 DSH 体验仍需用户验收。

## V0.5.5 Loader 条目兼容与手动检查（Unstable）

用 ConfigEditor 的 `entries()` 获取当前 profile 可编辑的 `dsh-hud` Loader entry，避免与 Host 纤程快捷条目不一致。实时监听 `loader/volatile-update`，并在扫描完成时一次性提交结果，规避多次配置重组。用户需在 Windows Desktop 中实际验证能检测到新版本、不显示长时间 Host 队列。原 HUD 纯色视觉、DSH 组件中心与自动更新授权均不改变。

## V0.5.6 浏览器只读检查（Unstable）

组件中心“检查更新”直接获取固定 GitHub Raw 源的公开 JSON 文件，校验来源、包名、版本、CI、源码提交与 SHA-256，无需通过 DSH Host 改写设置传递命令。浏览器网络/CORS 异常会明确提示，不应继续显示等待 Host。该按钮永不下载或安装插件；更新安装仍由 Host 负责。U056 需要用户实际安装后验证跨域访问与升级操作。

## V0.5.7 Windows 独立窗口候选（U057 待验收）

通过 HUD 组件中心打开一个单独的 WPF 原生无边框窗口，不显示最小化/最大化/关闭按钮，提供「返回 DSH」按钮。原 DSH 仅在新窗口可见后隐藏，窗口关闭时恢复；没有悬浮 HUD 入口。该版本使用打开时采集的只读会话快照，未实现 Electron BrowserWindow、透明/置顶或点击穿透。Windows PowerShell/WPF 需要在目标机可用；详情见 docs/HUD-NATIVE-WINDOW-V057.md。

## V0.5.8 启动超时修复

v0.5.7 的独立 HUD 启动仍通过 ConfigForms nonce 排队给 Host，Host 重建后可能直接消费新请求而不运行。v0.5.8 改为 DSH 正式 Connection RPC，一次按钮点击即发送启动 RPC，等待 WPF READY 并返回真实失败原因；窗口匹配不再依赖可能变化的 DSH 标题。仍只支持 Windows Desktop，U058 实机验收待完成。详情见 docs/HUD-NATIVE-WINDOW-V058.md。

## V0.5.9 多版本更新可靠性候选

手动更新改为「Host 按 SHA-256 验证固定包 → DSH 官方 Plugin Manager 直接安装」，避免旧 Host ConfigEditor 命令队列被重组中断；自动更新首次验证成功后记录单次尝试，三重实验授权保持不变。组件中心直接显示安装失败、需要重启或结果未知，超过限定时间不会持续显示正在安装。新增运行中 Host 版本探测，HTTP 405 提示完整退出并重启 Desktop。U059 Windows 实机结果未验证。详见 docs/HUD-INSTALL-RELIABILITY-V059.md。

# DSH HUD 插件与组件仓库

此项目为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供独立的 HUD 左侧导航入口、组件管理页面和基于公开 GitHub 的无 Token 更新能力。仓库更名后的标准地址为 **`OttoBlues/dsh-hud-plugin`**。

> 仓库名称与包名不同：DSH 中安装的插件继续叫 `@local/dsh-hud`，无需修改现有配置。仓库更名状态请参见 [核对说明](docs/REPOSITORY-RENAME.md)。

## 结构和职责

- `plugins/index.json`：HUD 组件总目录。
- `plugins/hud/index.js` 与 `client.js`：Host 及独立 UI，当前 **V0.5.8 试验源码**（保留 V0.5.6 的只读 GitHub 检查，并新增 Windows 独立无边框 WPF HUD）。
- `plugins/hud/unstable/`：只存储已登记的不可变试验安装包，当前最新 **V0.5.8**。
- `plugins/hud/released/`：用户批准后的正式发布通道，目前为空。
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`：仅使用 GitHub 托管 Linux、Windows 运行器执行检查与候选包结构验证。

**不再支持 Windows self-hosted Actions Runner。** 仓库不存在远程操控用户 Desktop、自动部署或 Runner 引导安装工作流。用户通过 HUD 自己的组件页面手动确认更新；可选自动更新也仅在用户主动授权后由 DSH Host 通过官方插件管理 API 执行，不依赖 GitHub Runner。

## 当前验收状态（2026-11-05）

用户已在 Windows DSH Desktop 成功更新至 **V0.4.2**，并反馈 V0.4.1 → V0.4.2 的更新过程中无报错、无需手动重启；完成后界面自动返回主会话。该现象可能是插件界面重新挂载，不能据此认定整个 DSH 进程重启。V0.4.0 更新曾出现 DSH 异常，本次 V0.4.2 更新未复现；未来 Windows 全局透明、置顶、鼠标穿透 HUD 尚未实现。

V0.4.2 已按用户要求作为 Unstable 试验包发布，更新仓库命名、组件说明并退休 Runner 工程。用户已在 HUD 内完成手动更新；GitHub CI 不会更改本地 Desktop。Released 通道仍为空，不因这一次升级顺利就自动晋升正式版。

## 开发与验证

```powershell
npm run check
npm run pack:hud
npm run verify:pack
```

此处本地 `dist/` 只用于开发包结构检查；真正可由 DSH 安装的版本仅来自 `released/` 或显式允许的 `unstable/`，必须有 SHA-256 和版本索引。

详见 [匿名更新机制](docs/AUTO-UPGRADE.md)、[发布规则](docs/RELEASE-POLICY.md)、[人工验收](docs/MANUAL-ACCEPTANCE.md) 和 [路线图](docs/ROADMAP.md)。

## V0.5.0 HUD 双模式工作区（开发中）

- HUD 不再只是组件管理页：可以显示覆盖 DSH 原三栏内容的全帧 HUD 工作区，保留原 DSH Session 与审批机制。
- 原 DSH 页面的 HUD 小入口、HUD 组件中心的「进入 HUD 模式」按钮可以进入；HUD 内提供「返回 DSH」和「组件中心」。
- 展示真实 Session 标题、运行状态与数量，不伪造 Agent 输出；本轮输入与高风险批准操作仍在 DSH 原生界面完成。
- HUD 工作区默认不启用；不覆盖 root Slot，不触碰 Electron 原生窗口或 Windows 系统层透明/穿透能力。
- V0.5.0 已作为 Unstable 试验包发布，用户需在 HUD 组件中心手动升级并完成 [U05 实机验收](docs/HUD-WORKSPACE-V050.md)；CI 通过不代表实际 Desktop 已运行成功。

## HUD V0.5.1 · 增强科幻线框视觉候选

V0.5.1 的设计候选为 **矢量线框/驾驶舱式 HUD**：切角边框、角部描边、深海军蓝底、淡网格、青色读数线、局部准星、控制台式信息层级。HUD 工作区与组件中心共享视觉风格，但仍展示真实 DSH 会话/组件数据，不伪造运行指标。

组件中心增加 **「检查更新」** 按钮，通过 Host 即时检查公开仓库的 `plugins/index.json`、`released` 与 `unstable` 发布索引，并显示成功、部分通道失败或网络失败、最近检查时间和使用的源。仅检查版本，不会执行安装或替代用户的明确升级确认。

**视觉风格尚未定稿**：这是供用户在 DSH V0.5.1 Unstable 实机体验后提出修改的候选版，不晋升 Released，也不撤销 HUD/DSH 切换与安全退出行为。详见 [视觉规范和验收](docs/HUD-VECTOR-STYLE-051.md)。

**试验版发布状态：** V0.5.1 已依据绿色 GitHub 托管 CI 制作固定安装包并加入 Unstable。用户需主动在 HUD 组件中心手动更新，实际检查更新按钮及科幻风格的验收尚未完成。

## HUD V0.5.2 · 第二轮视觉修正候选

用户 V0.5.1 实机截图反馈：原 SVG 拉伸描边在不同长宽面板上产生斜边失真和错位，且 HUD 舱体过于扁平；组件中心不应该整页采用深色 HUD 主题。V0.5.2 按 [视觉任务书](docs/HUD-VISUAL-REFORM-V052.md) 做以下改造：

- HUD 工作台仅用固定 12px CSS 切角及其对应的 10px 嵌板切角，不再按比例缩放整块矢量边线。
- 每个驾驶舱模块采用两层深色实体面板（外层金属框架/内层信息腔）和顶部一段弱高光；删除过量分段线、非数据绑定的准星和明显的网格。
- 组件中心改回 DSH 原生主题底座：继承 DSH 浅/深色，常规圆角与轻卡片；只用少量青蓝色品牌识别。
- 保留 HUD ⇄ DSH 切换、真实会话概览、安装确认与“检查更新”按钮及其失败诊断。

**重要：** V0.5.2 视觉仍待实机定稿，不包含全局 Windows 透明/置顶能力；代码合并与 CI 通过不等于自动安装或 GUI 通过。

**V0.5.2 发布进度：** 试验安装包经 GitHub 托管 CI 校验已登记在 Unstable，不是 Released；用户仍须从 DSH HUD 的组件中心手动确认安装。具体风格待 U052 实机截图与交互反馈最终确认。

## HUD V0.5.3 · 响应式更新检查与极简纯色驾驶舱

根据用户最新的 V0.5.2 Windows 截图，更新检查按钮曾长时间卡在「扫描版本源…」，并疑似影响五分钟后台轮询。V0.5.3 采取 **Host 全局限时扫描、ConfigEditor 写入限时、请求去重、前端 45 秒看门狗**；检查未被 DSH Host 确认时允许重新点击，避免永久锁住按钮。组件中心还显示最近后台检查时间和部分通道失败状态。Host 根因可能包括原网络请求未完成或热更新后配置写入卡住；具体哪一种仍需实机日志确定，不能仅凭截图断言。

HUD 改为**统一纯色**：背景深蓝 `#071522`，所有面板内填充 `#142b3a`，边框、细线和高亮统一 `#6dcbd2`，不再使用渐变或发光。组件中心继续继承 DSH 主题。

原 DSH 右上方悬浮 HUD 入口完全移除；只能从 DSH 左侧 **HUD → 组件中心 → 进入 HUD 模式** 进入，HUD 内仍保留“返回 DSH”和“组件中心”安全出口。DSH/Electron 原生的最小化、最大化和关闭按钮不在插件 UI 主题控制范围内，未擅自覆写系统标题栏。

本版仍需完整 CI + 用户实机 U053 验收后才考虑稳定化；参见 [V0.5.3 验收计划](docs/HUD-UPDATE-FLAT-V053.md)。

**V0.5.3 发布记录：** 固定源码提交 `c7e261f21a7267387556da6b8e08eb68f3b8d17a` 通过 GitHub 托管 CI `41913217218`；SHA-256 固定的 Unstable 安装包已提交。更新需要从 DSH 组件中心手动确认，不在用户电脑上自动安装；稳定性和最终配色需要 U053 真实环境验收。

## V0.5.4 开发修复：Host 检查请求不再被永久丢弃

V0.5.3 报告的手动检查超时已有一条**确认的源码故障路径**：Host 在成功承认更新检查之前就永久登记 nonce，以及在启动阶段缓存可能暂时不可用的 ConfigEditor。V0.5.4 修改为运行时动态获取配置编辑器，失败退避后可恢复检查同一请求，并将状态写入失败记录为警告而非“完成”。详细分析见 [V0.5.3 → V0.5.4 追踪](docs/HUD-UPDATE-FLAT-V053.md)。该修复仍需在用户真实 DSH 环境验收。

**V0.5.4 发布：** 经固定源码主分支 CI `41943053479` 验证后，发布至 Unstable，保持原 HUD 纯色工作区和 DSH 原生组件管理主题，修复状态写入失败后检查请求不可恢复的缺陷；真实 Windows DSH 检查效果仍待复验。

## V0.5.5 开发：调查“Host 未接收检查请求”

对 V0.5.4 的源码与 DSH 官方 ConfigEditor 实现交叉核对：编辑器只允许修改 `configEditor.entries()` 列出的可编辑 Loader 条目，而之前 HUD 采用 `ctx.fiber.entry` 快捷引用，可能存在条目身份不匹配。V0.5.5 按 `dsh-hud` profile entry ID 从官方编辑器列出的行定位，监听 `loader/volatile-update` 立即处理新检查请求；为了避免两次 profile reconcile，只在检查结束时一次性写回索引与结果。模拟纤程条目身份错误但可编辑条目正确、配置源不可编辑、配置事件即时到达的回归测试已添加。真实 Windows DSH 的问题是否彻底解决仍需实测确认。

**V0.5.5 Unstable 发布状态：** 固定源码提交 `d58439f40787e52a7742dbb8bf26eecf6516a56d` 经主分支 CI `41970014299` 验证，包体 SHA-256 已记录于版本索引。此修复是基于 DSH 官方 ConfigEditor API 的代码兼容性修正，是否解决用户设备上所有 Host 请求超时还需要独立测试；不晋升正式版。

## V0.5.6 架构修正：版本查询与 DSH Host 配置分离

用户 V0.5.5 实机反馈依然“DSH 更新服务未响应”。问题已超出多次修补 Host 配置编辑与事件通知的合理范围：`ConfigForms.mutate` 的正式职责是持久化 Loader 配置，而不是传输一次性后台命令。V0.5.6 新增由组件中心自身执行的**只读公开仓库扫描**，读取固定的 GitHub Raw 源和经校验的组件清单、Released/Unstable 索引；检查不调用配置写入，不排队 Host nonce，不安装包，因此不再会因为 Host 配置编辑失败卡在“等待检查结果”。如果浏览器由于网络或 CORS 限制无法访问，界面将明确显示错误并允许立即重试，而不是伪造最新版本。

真正的插件安装仍需原有 Host 读取、校验 SHA-256、核实最新通道并经用户确认。公开只读查询成功**不代表安装通道已通过验证**，必须经 Windows DSH 实机验收，必要时另行改进安装请求通道。

**V0.5.6 Unstable：** 主分支 CI `41972165734` 成功；固定 `.tgz` 与 SHA-256 已登记。该版本的用户触发只读检查脱离 DSH Host 配置队列，必须在用户 Windows Desktop 中检查跨域读取结果以及手动安装授权行为，CI 无法证明这些体验无故障。

## V0.5.7 Windows 独立 HUD（试验版候选）

从 HUD 组件中心主动打开 WPF 原生无边框窗口：新窗体不显示系统最小化、最大化、关闭按钮，提供「返回 DSH」按钮，显示后隐藏原 DSH，退出时恢复主窗口。与原有 DSH 内部 shell.overlay 视图不同，独立窗口是本地 PowerShell/WPF 辅助进程，当前只能读取打开时的会话快照，尚未实现 Electron 原生 BrowserWindow 集成、透明置顶或聊天输入。Linux 和 Windows CI 加入脚本/包结构检查，实机 U057 验收需由 Windows Desktop 用户执行。详见 [独立窗口说明](docs/HUD-NATIVE-WINDOW-V057.md)。

## V0.5.8 启动超时修复候选

用户报告 V0.5.7 独立 HUD 无窗口、触发超时。本版不再把独立窗口启动请求放进 DSH ConfigForms/Host 队列，而是调用 DSH 正式 Connection RPC，等待真实 WPF READY 并显示错误码；继续限制只能从 HUD 组件中心启动。Windows 主窗口查找改为确认 Electron 父进程、Chromium 窗口类型和唯一性，不再依赖可变标题。V0.5.8 已通过 GitHub Linux/Windows CI（含 WPF 实际渲染），固定包已登记 Unstable；真实 Windows U058 仍需人工验收。[具体修复与验收](docs/HUD-NATIVE-WINDOW-V058.md)。

## HUD v0.5.9 重复更新和独立 HUD Host 路由修复（U059 候选）

用户报告 v0.5.8 在同一 DSH 进程中连续更新时状态永久卡在「已确认，正在安装」，重启后版本生效，HUD 独立窗口启动请求返回 HTTP 405。v0.5.9 修改为 Host 按固定公开通道验证 SHA-256 安装包后，由 DSH 官方插件管理器直接执行安装；不再用插件 Loader 配置写入承担临时安装队列。后台自动更新采用按组件、版本和哈希去重的本地尝试账本。组件中心区分正在安装、实际失败、状态未知和必须重启，并探测运行 Host 版本，解释 404/405 的修复步骤。此功能仍需 Windows DSH Desktop 的人工 U059 验证；正式版 Released 不变。详见 [U059 修复与验收](docs/HUD-INSTALL-RELIABILITY-V059.md)。

# donsetch studio

[donsetch](https://github.com/dondai44423/donsetch) as a DeepSeek Harness plugin, with a panel that
shows what actually happened during a run: which engines answered, which were blocked, what each
page gave you, and how long every step took.

A list of results on its own doesn't tell you much. When a query comes back thin, you want to know
whether the other engines were blocked, slow, or just had nothing. That's what the panel is for.

## Tools

| tool | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `donsetch_search` | search the web, code, papers or news without an API key. Returns results with the engines that produced each one. |
| `donsetch_fetch` | fetch up to 12 URLs as markdown. Options for mode, tier, table of contents, links, and how much text to keep. |
| `donsetch_engines` | how each engine has been behaving across the runs recorded so far. |

## The panel

![a search run in the panel](docs/preview-search.png)

Pick a run on the left and read it on the right. For searches that means the wall time next to the
binary's own `meta.elapsed_ms`, a bar per engine coloured by status, how many results came back and
how many engines were blocked, the enrichment and top-up stages, and the markdown the tool returned.

![a fetch run in the panel](docs/preview-fetch.png)

For fetches you get one card per page: characters and words, whether the extraction was complete,
language and content kind, the HTTP status, the escalation trail from plain HTTP up to the headless
browser, and the markdown that came out.

You can also start a search or a fetch from the panel. It goes through the same code as the tools.

Timings are measured around the child process with `process.hrtime.bigint()`, so they include
startup. That's the number a caller actually waits for. The binary's internal number sits next to
it, and the gap between the two is part of the point.

## Install

The package is a bundle, so installing it adds the dependency and turns on `donsetch-studio` in the
profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:santera-pixel/donsetch-studio
```

In the app, open Settings → Plugins and paste `github:santera-pixel/donsetch-studio`. Running the
same command with `update` picks up new commits.

There's nothing to build. The checkout is plain ESM, so pnpm cloning it is the whole install.

### The binary arrives on first use

No binary is committed here. On first use the plugin downloads the pinned upstream release for your
platform, checks it against a SHA-256 that is written into this repository, and unpacks it into
`~/.dsh/.donsetch-studio/runtime/4.10.5/bin/`. That's about 17 MB, once per machine. The first run
that pays for it carries a `setup` note in the panel, so the cost isn't a mystery.

The release also publishes a `.sha256` next to each asset, and the installer reads it as a second
opinion. It isn't trusted on its own: that file lives in the same release as the archive, so whoever
could replace one could replace both. If the published digest ever disagrees with the pinned one, the
install stops and says so rather than quietly accepting whichever version answered. Targets without a
pinned digest (Linux, macOS) still install, and the marker records them as `checksumSource:
"release"` so it's clear which trust model applied.

Windows on ARM is covered by emulation rather than a native build, because upstream doesn't publish
one. A native ARM64 Node gets the x64 archive, which Windows 11 runs transparently; everything else
about that target, including the pinned digest, is the x64 target. Set `DONSETCH_BIN` instead if you
keep a native donsetch around.

If you'd rather not have that happen in the middle of a search:

```sh
node node_modules/donsetch-studio/scripts/setup.mjs
```

Or point `DONSETCH_BIN` at a donsetch you already have.

### Certificates

donsetch brings its own TLS stack, and when it can't find an OS certificate store it stops with
`tls: no root certs loaded`. That turns up in sandboxes and containers more often than you'd expect.
The plugin writes Node's own roots to `node-roots.pem` in the runtime cache and passes it to the
child through `SSL_CERT_FILE`, so it works without changing anything on the host.

## Where the runs go

Runs are saved to `runs.json`, capped at the 200 most recent, in `<DSH_PROFILE_DIR>/.donsetch-studio/`
when the host sets that, otherwise `<DSH_HOME>/.donsetch-studio/`, otherwise
`~/.dsh/.donsetch-studio/`. The desktop shell exports those variables empty, so on a normal install
it lands in `~/.dsh/.donsetch-studio/runs.json`. `GET /api/donsetch-studio/state` reports the
resolved path as `ledgerPath`, the size on disk, and the two retention settings below. A run that was
still in flight when the harness stopped comes back as interrupted instead of pretending it finished.

Each run stores its query, per-engine status and latency, the results with their scores, the
extraction stats of every page, and up to `contentCap` characters of the extracted markdown. The
panel's header says which of those apply, because a trace you can't audit the size of is a trace you
can't trust with a long crawl.

Two optional settings go in the patch row, next to the module name:

```yaml
donsetch-studio:
  maxRuns: 200      # runs kept on disk, 20–1000
  contentCap: 20000 # characters of page text per run, 1000–200000
  # contentCap: 0   # keep every timing and count, store no page text at all
```

`contentCap: 0` is a real setting rather than a floor: the ledger keeps what the engine panel needs
(engines, latencies, result counts, extraction stats) and drops the markdown. Values outside the
ranges are clamped, never trusted, so a hand-edited config can't make the ledger unbounded.

The panel updates over server-sent events, so a run started by the agent shows up without a reload.

Every bridge route, reads included, answers only same-origin callers: a request carrying a foreign
`Origin`, an opaque `null` origin from a sandboxed frame, or `Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site` gets a 403.
Requests with no `Origin` header (curl, the panel's own fetch) are what a same-origin caller looks
like, so they keep working. The ledger holds your queries, URLs and page text, and `GET` should not
be the word for "public".

## Tests

```
node test/runtime.mjs      # pinned digests, target lookup, tampered archive rejection
node test/ledger.mjs       # retention knobs, clamping, contentCap 0
node test/smoke.mjs        # real search and fetch, then the host half on a fake ctx
node test/render.mjs       # renders the panel from the live /state bridge
node test/shot.mjs         # writes docs/preview-*.html for the screenshots above
```

`smoke.mjs` needs a donsetch binary, from `DONSETCH_BIN` or the cache, same as the plugin. The other
three run on their own but are more useful once there are some runs to look at.

## Credits

The search and fetch engine is [donsetch](https://github.com/dondai44423/donsetch) by
[@dondai44423](https://github.com/dondai44423). The retrieval, extraction and ranking are all
theirs. This plugin adds the harness integration, the ledger, the panel, the pinned runtime download
and the certificate workaround. The panel uses the binary's own vocabulary for engines, stages,
escalation tiers and `content.extract`, so a run reads the same here as it does in donsetch's JSON.

## Licence

The plugin code is AGPL-3.0-only. donsetch itself is downloaded at first use from the upstream
releases and stays under its own AGPL-3.0 licence. Nothing of it is redistributed in this
repository.

No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

dsh-restart-handoff

DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的自动重启插件：改动必须重启才生效时，它替你重启，再把「为什么重启、接下来做什么」接回原来的会话——重启多少次，任务都不会断线。

简体中文 · English

> 普通的「重启」只是关掉再打开：你正在做的事全没了，得从头解释一遍自己在哪一步。 > 这个插件补上缺的那一半——**为什么重启、重启后第一步做什么**，跟着进程一起活下来。 ## 一句话 改完插件、装完工具，DSH（DeepSeek Harness）常会说一句「需要重启才生效」。手动重启意味着：关掉窗口、重新打开、自己回想刚才做到哪，再把需求重打一遍。 这个插件把这段空档填上：重启前把交接话写到磁盘，重开之后它作为新会话的第一条消息出现，模型照着往下做。**一个任务要重启五次，就续五次，中间不断线。** 它不改造你的模型，也不联网——只在本机读写几个状态文件。 ## 优势 **无限续接。** 每次重启都带一句「做到哪了、下一步做什么」过去，模型接着干而不是从头问。改一个插件要重启三次、改 harness 要重启十次，对话仍然是一条线。 **重启后模型知道前面发生了什么。** 交接话由模型自己在上下文最新鲜的时候写：为什么重启、这一轮做到哪、重启后第一步、哪些别重做。不是通用安慰话。 **改插件、改 Harness 的时候最明显。** 这两类改动几乎必然要求重启，而重启正是最容易丢上下文的时候——正是它存在的理由。 **不用你记，也不用你转述。** 没人再需要「我们刚才做到哪了」这句话；你回来时它已经在那儿了。 **重启本身不添乱。** 不打断正在回答的那一轮，等你所有窗口空下来，冷却 60 秒，拒绝时会说清还差几秒。 ## 你会用到它的四个时刻 **一、让 Agent 改插件代码** 改完，宿主回一句 `application: "restart-required"`。插件自己重启，几秒后你回到同一个会话，第一条消息就是交接话。 **二、你自己知道这一改得重启** 跟模型说一句「改完重启一下」。它调一次工具，顺手把交接话写掉，然后重启。 **三、你在改 DeepSeek Harness 自己** 改内置工具、改宿主代码、跑测试时反复重启——每一次都带着上一次的进度回来，不必重新描述需求。 **四、你现在就想要新版** 设置 →「重启交接」→ 点「现在重启」。这一种只重启，不会自动帮你续跑。 ## 重启后看到什么 不是固定模板，是模型自己写的四段话（排版由你在设置页定）： ```text ## DSH 已重启完成 · 15:04 - 起因：设置页的开关在暗色下看不见 - 做到哪了：开关底色改成层色，文档补了两行 - 接下来第一步：刷新窗口，确认暗色下的开关清晰 - 不用重做：不用再跑测试 ``` 某项模型没填，那一行整行消失，不会留下「下一步：（空）」。 兜底只在三种情况下出现：模型没写、5 分钟内没写、拿不到会话号——而且只有一句「DSH 刚重启好，继续没做完的部分。」 ## 它不会添乱的几个地方 - **等所有窗口都空下来**——不只是当前会话，子任务和别的窗口也在等，避免重启时把别人的回答掐掉。 - **不会连环重启**——两次重启之间至少隔 60 秒；一次重启只续跑一次，交接话最多投递 3 次。 - **拒绝时说清原因**——冷却期内点重启，界面会说「刚重启过，再等 42 秒」，而不是假装正在重开。 ## 和「手动重启」的差别 | | 手动重启 | 这个插件 | | --- | --- | --- | | 何时动手 | 你什么时候想起来就什么时候 | 这一轮答完、所有窗口空闲之后 | | 做到哪了 | 全靠你自己回忆 | 重启前写进交接话，重开就出现在眼前 | | 回答会被截断吗 | 随时可能 | 不会，等这一轮说完 | | 想反悔 | 已经关掉了 | 倒计时 5 秒内可以取消 | | 重复重启 | 可能反复关开 | 60 秒冷却，撞车时只重启一次 | ## 常见问题 ### 重启会丢掉正在跑的对话吗？ 不会。插件先等你这一轮答完、结果落盘，再等所有窗口空闲，然后才开始 5 秒倒计时。倒计时期间点「取消」就取消；来不及取消的时候，交接话已经写好，重开后会投回同一个会话。 ### 一个任务里连着重启好几次，上下文会断吗？ 不会。每重启一次就续一次：交接话跟着进程活下去，模型重开后先读它，再接着做。链条长了会变薄（每次只带得动一段摘要），但不会断成两截。 ### 它会不会自己反复重启？ 不会。两次重启之间强制隔 60 秒（`cooldownMs`），这期间任何来源的请求都会被挡下并说明还要等几秒。自动触发被挡下不会丢，冷却结束后自己重试一次。 ### 我只要重启，不要它自动接着说？ 设置里关掉「重启后自动接着做」。这时它只重启，不投递交接话，你回来说话就好。 ### 交接话的样式能自己定吗？ 能。设置页最下面就是模板编辑器，改一个字，右边预览立刻重排。模型只负责填内容（起因、做到哪、下一步、别重做，外加会话号与重启时刻），排版全按你的模板走。模板留空就恢复内置排版。 ### 需要联网吗？数据存在哪？ 完全不联网，没有任何外发请求。状态都在这几个本机文件里：`~/.dsh/restart-handoff/settings.json`（设置）、`pending.json`（待投递的交接话）、`history.jsonl`（事件）、`~/.dsh/restart-handoff.log`（日志）。删掉这个目录等于清空记录。 ### 支持 Windows、Linux 或网页版吗？ 不支持。它要重启的是 DSH 桌面版（Electron），所以在纯网页 / 命令行宿主里会直接回「只能在桌面版里重启」。目前只在 macOS 上验证过。 ### 会不会碰我的登录状态？ 只做一件事：每次启动，Electron 的 cookie 库里会多留一条 `dsh-auth-*` 记录，插件保留最新那条、删掉更早的（否则请求头越堆越大，服务端会报错）。这是它唯一触碰账号相关文件的地方，可以在「更多设置」里关掉。除此之外不读、不改任何内容。 ### 怎么卸载？ ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @saolence/dsh-restart-handoff ``` 卸掉后不再监听、不再重启；`~/.dsh/restart-handoff/` 里的记录可以留着，也可以删掉。 ## 安装 前提：**DSH 桌面版**。装完它会出现在设置页的「重启交接」里。 ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add @saolence/dsh-restart-handoff ``` > 必须是 `desktop` 这个 profile：它重启的是桌面 App，装进 `web` 不生效。 > > 改这个包**本身**不会热重载：profile 里指向它的是符号链接，HMR 收不到通知，改完要停用再启用一次（或重启一次）才生效。 ## 也支持 dsh web 桌面版之外，`dsh web` 这类命令行宿主也能用： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @saolence/dsh-restart-handoff ``` 用法一样，但重开的对象是那个 Node 进程，所以有三点不同： - **浏览器会新开一个标签**。`dsh web` 每次启动都会生成新的访问令牌，原来那个标签必然失效，插件会在新进程打印出地址后自动把它打开——旧标签关掉就行。 - **必须是从终端里启动的**。插件记下自己的命令行，退出后用同样的参数重放；交给 systemd、pm2 这类进程管理器管的，建议关掉自动重启，让管理器自己拉起来更稳。 - **`--no-open` 时不弹浏览器**，新地址记在 `~/.dsh/restart-handoff/cli-host.log` 里。 固定 `--port` 会更好（少一个变量），但不是必须：地址是抓出来的，端口变了也照样打开。 ## 设置里有什么 设置 →「重启交接」。最上面一行大字说明现在的情况，有事就变成倒计时或「等你忙完」。 三个常用开关： - **需要重开时自动帮我重启**（默认开） - **等所有任务都做完再重启**（默认开） - **重启后自动接着做**（默认开） 「更多设置」里还有三项：允许模型主动申请重启、每轮说完再动手、顺手清理过时的登录记录。 侧边栏账号行上方有一枚圆形按钮：空闲是 `↻`，排队时是暂停符，倒计时显示剩余秒数；点一下可以手动重启或取消。 ## 已知边界 - 只重启宿主，不重启你机器上的其他进程。 - 手动重启不续跑——那种时刻你人就在跟前。 - 交接话只在一次重启里有效，超过 10 分钟未投递就作废。 - Web GUI 需要带令牌的地址才能打开，插件不碰这块。 ## 开发者 细节都在源码里，这里只留入口：`index.js`（宿主逻辑）、`client.js`（界面）、`lib/state.js`（设置与状态文件）、`test/`（smoke / boot / client-contract 三组测试，`npm test`）。 改界面时有离线预览台，不依赖宿主： ```bash cp client.js test/preview/client.js python3 -m http.server 8781 --directory test/preview # 打开 http://127.0.0.1:8781/preview.html?s=idle ``` 参数：`s=idle|countdown|waiting|handoff|empty` 切场景，`theme=dark` 切暗色，`slot=sidebar.footer.action` 预览侧边栏那枚按钮。 ## 许可 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。当前版本 0.2.0。

# dsh-setup

[![validate](https://github.com/sergey-akhalkov/dsh-setup/actions/workflows/validate.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/sergey-akhalkov/dsh-setup/actions/workflows/validate.yml)
![DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.1--rc.5-blue)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

A portable setup for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) (DSH). Sixteen plugin
bundles add rules, skills, MCP access, second-model review, recovery guards, and memory to an agent
session; `@dsh-setup/setup` mounts all of them with working defaults, and one PowerShell command
reproduces the setup on another machine.

What changes in a session:

- The smallest complete change, with scope confirmed before it grows.
- A fix is proven by its original failure instead of asserted.
- Risky work comes back from a second model as a diff and a test report.
- A runaway loop or a stranded goal ends with a result or a named blocker.
- Context goes to the task: MCP tool schemas load on first use, bulky shell output is routed.
- The repository is remembered between sessions, locally.

Every plugin is also installable on its own; use either the full setup or the individual plugins for
a given plugin, never both, because both mount the same row.

## Install or update

### Install individual plugins from Discover

The setup and every plugin are listed in the published market index:

```text
https://sergey-akhalkov.github.io/dsh-setup/index.json
```

Enable **Custom plugin markets** (this adds the Discover tab), open **Discover**, and add that URL as
an index source. The index pins every listed version to a reviewed commit; install either the full
setup or individual plugins for a given plugin, never both, because both mount the same row. See
[Manual install](docs/install.md#manual-install) for the full steps.

Installing the **dsh-setup** entry from Discover mounts the setup and its plugin rows, but it does
not enable the other shipped DSH bundles (Agent Teams, tool worktree, Ralph, session search,
terminal). Enable them in **Plugins**, or use the full-setup command below. See
[Shipped DSH bundles](#shipped-dsh-bundles).

### Install the full setup with PowerShell

Use this on Windows when you want the complete setup in one command. Run it from an ordinary
PowerShell window, not from a terminal hosted by DeepSeek Harness. Start DeepSeek Harness once and
quit it first so the `desktop` profile exists.

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sergey-akhalkov/dsh-setup/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

The installer prints its plan, closes DeepSeek Harness, backs up the profile manifest and patch,
enables the shipped DSH bundles, installs or updates `@dsh-setup/setup` from the newest release,
verifies the result, provisions the local Hindsight runtime when `uv` and a DeepSeek key are
available, and starts the app again. **Rerun the same command to update**; when the newest release is
already installed, it changes nothing, and a configured Hindsight runtime is skipped without
prompting.

For `-DryRun`, a different profile, or a pinned version, download the script and run the file:

```powershell
$installer = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'dsh-setup-install.ps1'
Invoke-WebRequest https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sergey-akhalkov/dsh-setup/main/install.ps1 -OutFile $installer
& $installer -DryRun
```

All options, the manual install, and the update behavior are in [docs/install.md](docs/install.md).

## Dependencies

A missing optional runtime does not break startup: the affected adapter logs a failed connection, a
skill fails only when called, delegation reports the missing target, and everything else keeps
working. Install the runtimes for the plugins you want.

| Dependency                                                      | Needed for                                                              | Install                                                                                                                    |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 (0.2.1-rc.3 also supported) | Running any plugin; the installer refuses an unsupported version        | [Download DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)                                                          |
| PowerShell 5.1+ (7 recommended)                                 | The one-command installer                                               | [Install PowerShell](https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/scripting/install/installing-powershell)                       |
| Git                                                             | The installer fetches the setup through a commit-pinned git spec        | [Download Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads)                                                                              |
| Node.js with npm                                                | Installing the two global CLI prerequisites below                       | [Download Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en/download)                                                                         |
| `uv` (includes `uvx`)                                           | Serena MCP, every Codex delegation run, and the local Hindsight runtime | [Install uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/)                                                      |
| `@nuphus/nuphus-mcp`                                            | Nuphus MCP desktop and browser automation                               | `npm install -g @nuphus/nuphus-mcp`                                                                                        |
| `@fission-ai/openspec@1.15.0`                                   | The six OpenSpec skills                                                 | `npm install -g @fission-ai/openspec@1.15.0`                                                                               |

The installer also enables the optional DSH bundles the setup expects; the setup bundle does not
duplicate their rows:

- **Agent Teams** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile`) — durable teammates, a shared

- **Tool worktree** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-worktree`) — per-agent git worktrees, so

- **Ralph** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-ralph-bundle`) — fresh-agent iteration rounds toward one

- **Custom plugin markets** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-plugin-market-bundle`) — the **Discover**
  tab and external market-index sources.

## Development

Requires Node.js `>=24.18.0 <25` and the pinned pnpm `11.28.5` ([install
pnpm](https://pnpm.io/installation)).

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check        # typecheck, lint, build, tests
pnpm validate     # full local gate, including generated-file and installer checks
pnpm dogfood      # Windows: verify install.ps1 against a copy of this machine's profile
```

Generated files are committed: the setup patch, `lib/` output, and `client.js` bundles are built
ahead of time so bundles install from git without an install-time build step. Run `pnpm gen` after
changing a composition fragment and `pnpm build` after changing TypeScript sources; CI rejects a
commit whose generated files do not match their sources.

## Documentation

- [Install, update, manual install](docs/install.md)
- [Plugin development](docs/plugins.md)
- [Setup composition and the generated bundle](docs/setup-composition.md)
- [Releases, Pages, and the market index](docs/releasing.md)
- [Delegation rules](docs/delegation-rules.md) and the [Codex subagent](docs/codex-subagent.md)
- Plugin notes: [Ponytail](docs/ponytail.md), [working principles](docs/principles.md),
  [RTK](docs/rtk.md), [Rust](docs/rust.md), [Serena](docs/serena.md), [OpenSpec](docs/openspec.md),
  [Loop guard](docs/loop-guard.md)
- Repository operating guide: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)

## Security

Installing a bundle runs its code with the permissions of the Harness process. Market entries pin an
exact git commit so the reviewed source and the running code are the same revision. Third-party
prompts and skills are vendored with provenance locks (`ponytail.lock.json`, `openspec.lock.json`)
that offline tests verify. The installer closes DeepSeek Harness while it writes the profile, saves a
manifest backup, and changes only the bundle selection and installed packages — never the profile's
own patch. This repository contains no credentials, sessions, or machine-specific paths.

`packages/plugin-ponytail/assets/ponytail/`, the OpenSpec skills in
`packages/plugin-openspec/assets/openspec/`, and the Codex subagent provider in
`packages/plugin-codex-subagent/`.

# dsh-setup

[![validate](https://github.com/sergey-akhalkov/dsh-setup/actions/workflows/validate.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/sergey-akhalkov/dsh-setup/actions/workflows/validate.yml)
![DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.1--rc.5-blue)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

A portable setup for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) (DSH). Sixteen plugin
bundles add rules, skills, MCP access, second-model review, recovery guards, and memory to an agent
session; `@dsh-setup/setup` mounts all of them with working defaults, and one PowerShell command
reproduces the setup on another machine.

What changes in a session:

- The smallest complete change, with scope confirmed before it grows.
- A fix is proven by its original failure instead of asserted.
- Risky work comes back from a second model as a diff and a test report.
- A runaway loop or a stranded goal ends with a result or a named blocker.
- Context goes to the task: MCP tool schemas load on first use, bulky shell output is routed.
- The repository is remembered between sessions, locally.

Every plugin is also installable on its own; use either the full setup or the individual plugins for
a given plugin, never both, because both mount the same row.

## Install or update

### Install individual plugins from Discover

The setup and every plugin are listed in the published market index:

```text
https://sergey-akhalkov.github.io/dsh-setup/index.json
```

Enable **Custom plugin markets** (this adds the Discover tab), open **Discover**, and add that URL as
an index source. The index pins every listed version to a reviewed commit; install either the full
setup or individual plugins for a given plugin, never both, because both mount the same row. See
[Manual install](docs/install.md#manual-install) for the full steps.

Installing the **dsh-setup** entry from Discover mounts the setup and its plugin rows, but it does
not enable the other shipped DSH bundles (Agent Teams, tool worktree, Ralph, session search,
terminal). Enable them in **Plugins**, or use the full-setup command below. See
[Shipped DSH bundles](#shipped-dsh-bundles).

### Install the full setup with PowerShell

Use this on Windows when you want the complete setup in one command. Run it from an ordinary
PowerShell window, not from a terminal hosted by DeepSeek Harness. Start DeepSeek Harness once and
quit it first so the `desktop` profile exists.

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sergey-akhalkov/dsh-setup/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

The installer prints its plan, closes DeepSeek Harness, backs up the profile manifest and patch,
enables the shipped DSH bundles, installs or updates `@dsh-setup/setup` from the newest release,
verifies the result, provisions the local Hindsight runtime when `uv` and a DeepSeek key are
available, and starts the app again. **Rerun the same command to update**; when the newest release is
already installed, it changes nothing, and a configured Hindsight runtime is skipped without
prompting.

For `-DryRun`, a different profile, or a pinned version, download the script and run the file:

```powershell
$installer = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'dsh-setup-install.ps1'
Invoke-WebRequest https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sergey-akhalkov/dsh-setup/main/install.ps1 -OutFile $installer
& $installer -DryRun
```

All options, the manual install, and the update behavior are in [docs/install.md](docs/install.md).

## Dependencies

A missing optional runtime does not break startup: the affected adapter logs a failed connection, a
skill fails only when called, delegation reports the missing target, and everything else keeps
working. Install the runtimes for the plugins you want.

| DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 (0.2.1-rc.3 also supported) | Running any plugin; the installer refuses an unsupported version        | [Download DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)                                                          |
| PowerShell 5.1+ (7 recommended)                                 | The one-command installer                                               | [Install PowerShell](https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/scripting/install/installing-powershell)                       |
| Git                                                             | The installer fetches the setup through a commit-pinned git spec        | [Download Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads)                                                                              |

| [`@dsh-setup/plugin-hindsight`](packages/plugin-hindsight)                   | Native Hindsight memory + one-click local bootstrap                                                                     | Reuses the official native DSH plugin for automatic recall, retention, knowledge pages, and `hindsight_*` tools; defaults to a local `hindsight-embed` daemon at `127.0.0.1:8888` and autostarts it when unhealthy. The one-command installer provisions the runtime after the profile phase; `setup-hindsight.ps1` runs only that phase. Disable the row or set `autostart: false` to opt out. See [Hindsight](docs/hindsight.md).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| [`@dsh-setup/plugin-codex-subagent`](packages/plugin-codex-subagent)         | Codex subagent provider with a pinned bundled CLI                                                                       | A second model for reviews, blockers, research, and bug-fix patches; runs `@openai/codex` 0.164.0, reuses your `~/.codex` login, and pins its Serena MCP setup. One login is required; `codex_subagent_status` reports the command and the resolved CLI.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| [`@dsh-setup/plugin-admin-indicator`](packages/plugin-admin-indicator)       | Desktop administrator label + shortcut                                                                                  | Shows whether the Desktop app is elevated with the visible **Standard User**/**Administrator** badge next to the composer permission control; the menu creates an administrator desktop shortcut and shows a native success toast. The restart action is behind the default-off `restart` flag pending live UAC verification.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| [`@dsh-setup/plugin-observability`](packages/plugin-observability)           | Observability dashboard: plugin health and signal counts derived from session logs (no second log)                      | Answers whether a rule actually fired and a plugin is still working: a health verdict and KPI strip, an activity/error chart, plugin health cards grouped by attention with status words (active, error, not loaded, silent), tool distribution, and details on demand. The shipped per-plugin signal map covers every plugin; guidance rows name prompt-only plugins, and the blind spots are stated rather than hidden. Reads the session logs on demand and keeps nothing. See [plugins](docs/plugins.md#observability-view).                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| [`@dsh-setup/plugin-verification-gate`](packages/plugin-verification-gate)   | Host turn-close gate (no per-step prompt cost)                                                                          | Refuses to close a code-changing turn until one configured check command has succeeded after the last `edit`/`write`; inert with no `commands`, capped after `maxBlocks` (default 8) consecutive refusals, and only the configured command (optionally prefixed by one `rtk ` token) satisfies it. See [verification-gate](docs/verification-gate.md).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

[`@dsh-setup/setup`](packages/setup) is the meta-bundle: one install mounts all sixteen plugins and
applies the owner defaults, and its publishable files are vendored so a git install needs no build
step.

### Shipped DSH bundles

The installer also enables the optional DSH bundles the setup expects; the setup bundle does not
duplicate their rows:

- **Agent Teams** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile`) — durable teammates, a shared
  task board, and isolated write scopes for parallel work.
- **Tool worktree** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-worktree`) — per-agent git worktrees, so
  separate agents write without touching the same checkout.
- **Ralph** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-ralph-bundle`) — fresh-agent iteration rounds toward one
  immutable objective.
- **Custom plugin markets** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-plugin-market-bundle`) — the **Discover**
  tab and external market-index sources.
- **Session search** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-session-search`) — search across prior sessions.
- **Terminal** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-terminal-bundle`) — persistent terminal sessions for
  REPL and interactive work.

## Development

Requires Node.js `>=24.18.0 <25` and the pinned pnpm `11.28.5` ([install
pnpm](https://pnpm.io/installation)).

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check        # typecheck, lint, build, tests
pnpm validate     # full local gate, including generated-file and installer checks
pnpm dogfood      # Windows: verify install.ps1 against a copy of this machine's profile
```

Generated files are committed: the setup patch, `lib/` output, and `client.js` bundles are built
ahead of time so bundles install from git without an install-time build step. Run `pnpm gen` after
changing a composition fragment and `pnpm build` after changing TypeScript sources; CI rejects a
commit whose generated files do not match their sources.

## Documentation

- [Install, update, manual install](docs/install.md)
- [Plugin development](docs/plugins.md)
- [Setup composition and the generated bundle](docs/setup-composition.md)
- [Releases, Pages, and the market index](docs/releasing.md)
- [Delegation rules](docs/delegation-rules.md) and the [Codex subagent](docs/codex-subagent.md)
- Plugin notes: [Ponytail](docs/ponytail.md), [working principles](docs/principles.md),
  [RTK](docs/rtk.md), [Rust](docs/rust.md), [Serena](docs/serena.md), [OpenSpec](docs/openspec.md),
  [Loop guard](docs/loop-guard.md)
- Repository operating guide: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)

## Security

Installing a bundle runs its code with the permissions of the Harness process. Market entries pin an
exact git commit so the reviewed source and the running code are the same revision. Third-party
prompts and skills are vendored with provenance locks (`ponytail.lock.json`, `openspec.lock.json`)
that offline tests verify. The installer closes DeepSeek Harness while it writes the profile, saves a
manifest backup, and changes only the bundle selection and installed packages — never the profile's
own patch. This repository contains no credentials, sessions, or machine-specific paths.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE), copyright (c) 2026 Sergey Akhalkov. It covers the original code and documentation in
this repository. Vendored third-party content keeps its upstream MIT license and attribution, with
the upstream license shipped beside the files: the Ponytail prompt in
`packages/plugin-ponytail/assets/ponytail/`, the OpenSpec skills in
`packages/plugin-openspec/assets/openspec/`, and the Codex subagent provider in
`packages/plugin-codex-subagent/`.

# @dsh-setup/plugin-codex-subagent

A DeepSeek Harness Host bundle that adds a Codex subagent target running a
**bundled, pinned Codex CLI**: `@openai/codex` `0.164.0`. It is an
MIT-attributed fork of the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex`
0.2.1-rc.3 provider; the difference is bundled/installed binary resolution,
Serena MCP configuration, target options, and provider/status wiring, not the
Codex app-server protocol. The repository commits no Codex binary.

## Prerequisite: log in to the bundled Codex once

The first install fetches `@openai/codex` and its platform-specific optional
dependency (the `codex`/`codex.exe` binary) through the profile's package
manager. Then run the bundled CLI once to sign in:

```sh
<resolved codex executable> login
```

`codex_subagent_status` prints the exact command for the resolved CLI. The
login writes the usual `~/.codex/auth.json`; the fork does not sign in or copy
credentials, and it makes no direct writes to `~/.codex` — `config.toml` stays
byte-identical, though Codex may refresh its own auth tokens during a run. A
not-logged-in run is reported as an authentication failure with that login
command as the next action.

The Serena MCP tools require `uvx` and `serena-agent==1.7.0` on the machine.
Serena is a required MCP server for every run, so a missing runtime fails the
run with that next action instead of silently dropping the tools.

## Discovery

For every run (and for the status tool) the fork resolves the CLI in this order:

1. `codexPath` from the plugin row config — an absolute path, a relative path, or
   a command name.
2. The pinned bundled `@openai/codex` platform binary from the installed
   dependency (`vendor/<target-triple>/bin/codex`).
3. `codex` on `PATH` (Windows `PATHEXT` candidates, `.exe`/`.cmd`/`.bat`).

The resolved executable is validated with `codex --version` before any app-server
starts. `PATH` is tried only when `codexPath` is omitted and no bundled platform
binary is discovered; a discovered but invalid executable is terminal and is not
replaced by another source. Discovery and validation failures report the source,
path, and next actions. Windows `.cmd`/`.bat` shims are started through `ComSpec`
with every argument as its own argv entry; `.exe` files, including the bundled
one, start directly. The delegation prompt is never interpolated into a command
line: it reaches the app-server over stdin.

## Serena MCP configuration

Every app-server starts with fixed Codex `-c` overrides that make the Serena MCP
server available:

```text
-c mcp_servers.serena.command=uvx
-c mcp_servers.serena.args=["--from","serena-agent==1.7.0","serena","start-mcp-server","--context=vscode","--enable-web-dashboard=false","--enable-gui-log-window=false","--project","<run working directory>"]
-c mcp_servers.serena.enabled=true
-c mcp_servers.serena.required=true
-c mcp_servers.serena.cwd=<run working directory>
-c mcp_servers.serena.env.SERENA_HOME=<throwaway Serena home>
-c mcp_servers.serena.startup_timeout_sec=120
-c mcp_servers.serena.tool_timeout_sec=120
```

`--project=<run working directory>` makes the run's exact working directory the
active Serena project. It replaces `--project-from-cwd`, which resolves the
nearest ancestor with `.git`/`.serena` and would activate (and possibly rewrite)
an ancestor checkout for a nested run. The server `cwd` is pinned to the same
exact directory so an inherited cwd cannot win. Every run gets a throwaway
`SERENA_HOME` (pinned via the per-server `env`, because Codex starts MCP children
with its own environment) whose minimal `serena_config.yml` sets `projects: []`,
empty `trusted_project_path_patterns`, and a `project_serena_folder_location`
under that home. The resolved `projects/<basename(cwd)>` directory is created
before spawn, so Serena uses the run-scoped data folder instead of falling back
to and rewriting a checkout
`.serena/project.yml`; the user's `~/.serena` config is not read or rewritten,
and an inherited trusted activation hook cannot run. The GUI log window is
disabled, and the home is removed on dispose.

They mirror the setup's lazy `serena` entry, contain no credentials, and
never rewrite `~/.codex/config.toml`. The child explicitly unsets `CODEX_HOME`,
so the existing `~/.codex` login and config apply. `enabled=true` wins over an
inherited `enabled=false`, and `required=true` makes a missing Serena runtime
fail the run with the fixed next action instead of silently dropping the tools.

Both provider instances add a fixed `mcp_servers.serena.disabled_tools=[...]`
override listing the mutating Serena tools (content/symbol edits, memory writes)
plus `activate_project`, whose trusted activation hook can run a shell. Serena's
MCP tools run outside the Codex sandbox, so the disable list and the throwaway
home block inherited approvals/hooks from editing files: a review stays
read-only, and a patch run cannot escape its isolated worktree through Serena.
Writes then go only through the Codex sandbox in that worktree. The override
replaces any inherited `disabled_tools` list.

## Providers

One row registers two provider instances under fixed names:

| Provider               | Sandbox           | Use                                     |
| ---------------------- | ----------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `codex-subagent`       | `read-only`       | review and answer contracts             |
| `codex-subagent-write` | `workspace-write` | patch contracts in an isolated worktree |

Both use Codex's non-interactive `approvalPolicy: never`; the sandbox fixes the
permission boundary, so a read-only rule cannot silently escalate. The official
`codex` provider (from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex`) may be registered in the
same profile; the fork's names are distinct.

## Target model and reasoning effort

The providers advertise `capabilities.agentOptions: true` and accept the DSH
subagent start request's `{ model, reasoningEffort }`:

- `model` → Codex `thread/start` `model`;
- `reasoningEffort` → Codex `thread/start` `config.model_reasoning_effort`.

A target value overrides the row default; a target without values keeps the row
default or the user's Codex `config.toml` route. Any other `agentOptions` entry
is rejected before a process starts with a `subagent-codex:` diagnostic naming
the unsupported option. Invalid model/effort strings are passed through and
surfaced as a normal non-completed run diagnostic, which the rules engine records
as an ERROR.

## Status tool

`codex_subagent_status` reports the resolved path, version, source (`config`,
`bundled`, or `PATH`), bundled `@openai/codex` version, the fixed Serena command,
`~/.codex`, the exact login command, and a paste-ready profile row snippet. The
fork makes no direct writes to the profile or `~/.codex` (`config.toml` stays
byte-identical; Codex may refresh its own auth tokens during a run). To pin a
detected CLI, add the snippet to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`; a patch
replaces the whole row config, so a `codexPath`-only override is enough for this
row:

```yaml
- id: dsh-setup-codex-subagent
  config:
    codexPath: <absolute path to a codex executable>
```

To turn the providers and tool off, disable the row or remove the bundle.

## Configuration

Row config fields:

| Field             | Default | Meaning                                                   |
| ----------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `codexPath`       | unset   | CLI override; unset uses the bundled binary, then PATH    |
| `model`           | unset   | default native Codex model for both instances             |
| `reasoningEffort` | unset   | default Codex reasoning effort for both instances         |
| `env`             | `{}`    | explicit child environment entries layered over the scrub |
| `disposeGraceMs`  | `3000`  | grace between app-server termination tiers                |

Example with explicit defaults:

```yaml
- id: dsh-setup-codex-subagent
  config:
    model: gpt-6-astra
    reasoningEffort: xhigh
```

The model and effort belong to this row or the delegation target; subscription,
auth, sandbox defaults, MCP servers, and skills come from the bundled CLI and the
user's Codex home.

## Cost and safety

A delegation starts one Codex app-server, creates one ephemeral thread, and runs
one turn: it costs a Codex request and tokens on your account, and reviews are
slow by nature. Per-task reviews multiply the runs; the rules engine's task
progress note is the cheap alternative. The user's Codex sandbox and config
govern the target's permissions; the fork adds no approval UI and grants nothing
interactively. Stderr from Codex is forwarded to the Harness process stderr.
Spawn argv and Serena overrides are fixed; prompt text only travels over stdin.

## App-server compatibility

The retained adapter was written against Codex app-server 0.153.4 and was
verified against the bundled `@openai/codex` 0.164.0, including a completed
authenticated turn on the owner's `~/.codex` login: `initialize`/`initialized`,
`thread/start` with an ephemeral thread, sandbox, approval policy, target model
and effort, `turn/start` with text input, the `agentMessage` `final_answer`
notification, and `turn/completed` all worked; the fixed Serena `-c` overrides
were accepted. A signed-out run is reported as a non-completed run with HTTP 401
and the login next action. If a future bundled Codex version changes the
protocol, patch `lib/index.js`/`lib/types/wire.d.ts` and re-run this package's
tests plus the live acceptance.

## Upstream, license, and rebase

- Upstream provider: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex` version `0.2.1-rc.3`, MIT,
  Copyright (c) 2026 DeepSeek, from the DeepSeek Harness repository
  (`packages/subagent/subagent-codex`).
- Bundled CLI: `@openai/codex` `0.164.0`, Apache-2.0, Copyright OpenAI, installed
  from npm with its platform optional dependency. No binary is committed.
- `LICENSE` is the upstream MIT text; `NOTICE` records the fork, the bundled
  dependency, and every local change.
- Local changes are limited to: bundled/`codexPath`/PATH discovery and
  `codex --version` validation (`lib/index.js` resolve region), fixed Serena `-c`
  overrides, `--project-from-cwd`, the per-run throwaway `SERENA_HOME` with an
  empty trusted-path list, `CODEX_HOME` unset, target
  `model`/`reasoningEffort` mapping, login diagnostics, Windows `ComSpec`
  spawning, fixed read-only/workspace-write sandboxes, two provider
  registrations, the `codex_subagent_status` tool, `Config` fields (`codexPath`,
  `model`, `reasoningEffort`, no `providerName`/`permissionMode`), and
  declaration/import updates under `lib/types/`. The app-server adapter and child
  lifecycle are upstream code.

Rebase procedure on a DSH support bump:

1. Copy `lib/index.js` and `lib/types/{index,run,wire}.d.ts` from the matching
   `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex` release.
2. Re-apply the local changes listed above.
3. Keep `NOTICE`'s upstream version current.
4. Run `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-codex-subagent/test`, then the live
   app-server handshake/turn acceptance, before release.

Codex version bumps change the `@openai/codex` dependency, lockfile, NOTICE,
status-reported version, and the live acceptance together; the app-server
protocol is verified against the pinned version, not assumed.

The copied code lives only in this package; the generic delegation-rules engine
does not import Codex.

# dsh-setup

[![validate](https://github.com/sergey-akhalkov/dsh-setup/actions/workflows/validate.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/sergey-akhalkov/dsh-setup/actions/workflows/validate.yml)
![DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.1--rc.5-blue)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

A portable setup for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) (DSH). Sixteen plugin
bundles add rules, skills, MCP access, second-model review, recovery guards, and memory to an agent
session; `@dsh-setup/setup` mounts all of them with working defaults, and one PowerShell command
reproduces the setup on another machine.

What changes in a session:

- The smallest complete change, with scope confirmed before it grows.
- A fix is proven by its original failure instead of asserted.
- Risky work comes back from a second model as a diff and a test report.
- A runaway loop or a stranded goal ends with a result or a named blocker.
- Context goes to the task: MCP tool schemas load on first use, bulky shell output is routed.
- The repository is remembered between sessions, locally.

Every plugin is also installable on its own; use either the full setup or the individual plugins for
a given plugin, never both, because both mount the same row.

## Install or update

### Install individual plugins from Discover

The setup and every plugin are listed in the published market index:

```text
https://sergey-akhalkov.github.io/dsh-setup/index.json
```

Enable **Custom plugin markets** (this adds the Discover tab), open **Discover**, and add that URL as
an index source. The index pins every listed version to a reviewed commit; install either the full
setup or individual plugins for a given plugin, never both, because both mount the same row. See
[Manual install](docs/install.md#manual-install) for the full steps.

Installing the **dsh-setup** entry from Discover mounts the setup and its plugin rows, but it does
not enable the other shipped DSH bundles (Agent Teams, tool worktree, Ralph, session search,
terminal). Enable them in **Plugins**, or use the full-setup command below. See
[Shipped DSH bundles](#shipped-dsh-bundles).

### Install the full setup with PowerShell

Use this on Windows when you want the complete setup in one command. Run it from an ordinary
PowerShell window, not from a terminal hosted by DeepSeek Harness. Start DeepSeek Harness once and
quit it first so the `desktop` profile exists.

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sergey-akhalkov/dsh-setup/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

The installer prints its plan, closes DeepSeek Harness, backs up the profile manifest and patch,
enables the shipped DSH bundles, installs or updates `@dsh-setup/setup` from the newest release,
verifies the result, provisions the local Hindsight runtime when `uv` and a DeepSeek key are
available, and starts the app again. **Rerun the same command to update**; when the newest release is
already installed, it changes nothing, and a configured Hindsight runtime is skipped without
prompting.

For `-DryRun`, a different profile, or a pinned version, download the script and run the file:

```powershell
$installer = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'dsh-setup-install.ps1'
Invoke-WebRequest https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sergey-akhalkov/dsh-setup/main/install.ps1 -OutFile $installer
& $installer -DryRun
```

All options, the manual install, and the update behavior are in [docs/install.md](docs/install.md).

## Dependencies

A missing optional runtime does not break startup: the affected adapter logs a failed connection, a
skill fails only when called, delegation reports the missing target, and everything else keeps
working. Install the runtimes for the plugins you want.

| Dependency                                                      | Needed for                                                              | Install                                                                                                                    |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 (0.2.1-rc.3 also supported) | Running any plugin; the installer refuses an unsupported version        | [Download DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)                                                          |
| PowerShell 5.1+ (7 recommended)                                 | The one-command installer                                               | [Install PowerShell](https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/scripting/install/installing-powershell)                       |
| Git                                                             | The installer fetches the setup through a commit-pinned git spec        | [Download Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads)                                                                              |
| Node.js with npm                                                | Installing the two global CLI prerequisites below                       | [Download Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en/download)                                                                         |
| `uv` (includes `uvx`)                                           | Serena MCP, every Codex delegation run, and the local Hindsight runtime | [Install uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/)                                                      |
| `@nuphus/nuphus-mcp`                                            | Nuphus MCP desktop and browser automation                               | `npm install -g @nuphus/nuphus-mcp`                                                                                        |
| `@fission-ai/openspec@1.15.0`                                   | The six OpenSpec skills                                                 | `npm install -g @fission-ai/openspec@1.15.0`                                                                               |
| `rtk`                                                           | The RTK routing rule and skill                                          | [Install RTK](https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk#installation)                                                                  |
| Codex CLI (bundled)                                             | The Codex subagent and the default delegation target                    | No separate install: the bundle ships `@openai/codex` 0.164.0; log in once with the command `codex_subagent_status` prints |

## What the setup installs

All sixteen plugin bundles are mounted and enabled by default, and the setup applies owner defaults:
the `deepseek-flash` model at max reasoning effort, the dark theme, detailed transcript and usage
display, and the `cordis` agent preset. A profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` still outranks these
defaults.

"Always-on" contributions are a system-prompt section paid on every model step; on-demand skills are
listed in the catalog and load only when invoked.

### Plugin bundles

| Plugin                                                                       | Enabled contribution                                                                                                    | What it gives you                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| [`@dsh-setup/plugin-ponytail`](packages/plugin-ponytail)                     | Always-on ruleset + `ponytail` skill                                                                                    | Minimal-code discipline: the smallest complete change, no unrequested abstractions, a reply a busy person reads once. # dsh-setup

[![validate](https://github.com/sergey-akhalkov/dsh-setup/actions/workflows/validate.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/sergey-akhalkov/dsh-setup/actions/workflows/validate.yml)
![DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.1--rc.5-blue)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

A portable setup for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) (DSH). Sixteen plugin
bundles add rules, skills, MCP access, second-model review, recovery guards, and memory to an agent
session; `@dsh-setup/setup` mounts all of them with working defaults, and one PowerShell command
reproduces the setup on another machine.

What changes in a session:

- The smallest complete change, with scope confirmed before it grows.
- A fix is proven by its original failure instead of asserted.
- Risky work comes back from a second model as a diff and a test report.
- A runaway loop or a stranded goal ends with a result or a named blocker.
- Context goes to the task: MCP tool schemas load on first use, bulky shell output is routed.
- The repository is remembered between sessions, locally.

Every plugin is also installable on its own; use either the full setup or the individual plugins for
a given plugin, never both, because both mount the same row.

## Install or update

### Install individual plugins from Discover

The setup and every plugin are listed in the published market index:

```text
https://sergey-akhalkov.github.io/dsh-setup/index.json
```

Enable **Custom plugin markets** (this adds the Discover tab), open **Discover**, and add that URL as
an index source. The index pins every listed version to a reviewed commit; install either the full
setup or individual plugins for a given plugin, never both, because both mount the same row. See
[Manual install](docs/install.md#manual-install) for the full steps.

Installing the **dsh-setup** entry from Discover mounts the setup and its plugin rows, but it does
not enable the other shipped DSH bundles (Agent Teams, tool worktree, Ralph, session search,
terminal). Enable them in **Plugins**, or use the full-setup command below. See
[Shipped DSH bundles](#shipped-dsh-bundles).

### Install the full setup with PowerShell

Use this on Windows when you want the complete setup in one command. Run it from an ordinary
PowerShell window, not from a terminal hosted by DeepSeek Harness. Start DeepSeek Harness once and
quit it first so the `desktop` profile exists.

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sergey-akhalkov/dsh-setup/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

The installer prints its plan, closes DeepSeek Harness, backs up the profile manifest and patch,
enables the shipped DSH bundles, installs or updates `@dsh-setup/setup` from the newest release,
verifies the result, provisions the local Hindsight runtime when `uv` and a DeepSeek key are
available, and starts the app again. **Rerun the same command to update**; when the newest release is
already installed, it changes nothing, and a configured Hindsight runtime is skipped without
prompting.

For `-DryRun`, a different profile, or a pinned version, download the script and run the file:

```powershell
$installer = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'dsh-setup-install.ps1'
Invoke-WebRequest https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sergey-akhalkov/dsh-setup/main/install.ps1 -OutFile $installer
& $installer -DryRun
```

All options, the manual install, and the update behavior are in [docs/install.md](docs/install.md).

## Dependencies

A missing optional runtime does not break startup: the affected adapter logs a failed connection, a
skill fails only when called, delegation reports the missing target, and everything else keeps
working. Install the runtimes for the plugins you want.

| Dependency                                                      | Needed for                                                              | Install                                                                                                                    |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 (0.2.1-rc.3 also supported) | Running any plugin; the installer refuses an unsupported version        | [Download DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)                                                          |
| PowerShell 5.1+ (7 recommended)                                 | The one-command installer                                               | [Install PowerShell](https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/scripting/install/installing-powershell)                       |
| Git                                                             | The installer fetches the setup through a commit-pinned git spec        | [Download Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads)                                                                              |
| Node.js with npm                                                | Installing the two global CLI prerequisites below                       | [Download Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en/download)                                                                         |
| `uv` (includes `uvx`)                                           | Serena MCP, every Codex delegation run, and the local Hindsight runtime | [Install uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/)                                                      |
| `@nuphus/nuphus-mcp`                                            | Nuphus MCP desktop and browser automation                               | `npm install -g @nuphus/nuphus-mcp`                                                                                        |
| `@fission-ai/openspec@1.15.0`                                   | The six OpenSpec skills                                                 | `npm install -g @fission-ai/openspec@1.15.0`                                                                               |

All sixteen plugin bundles are mounted and enabled by default, and the setup applies owner defaults:
the `deepseek-flash` model at max reasoning effort, the dark theme, detailed transcript and usage
display, and the `cordis` agent preset. A profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` still outranks these
defaults.

## Development

Requires Node.js `>=24.18.0 <25` and the pinned pnpm `11.28.5` ([install
pnpm](https://pnpm.io/installation)).

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check        # typecheck, lint, build, tests
pnpm validate     # full local gate, including generated-file and installer checks
pnpm dogfood      # Windows: verify install.ps1 against a copy of this machine's profile
```

Generated files are committed: the setup patch, `lib/` output, and `client.js` bundles are built
ahead of time so bundles install from git without an install-time build step. Run `pnpm gen` after
changing a composition fragment and `pnpm build` after changing TypeScript sources; CI rejects a
commit whose generated files do not match their sources.

## Documentation

- [Install, update, manual install](docs/install.md)
- [Plugin development](docs/plugins.md)
- [Setup composition and the generated bundle](docs/setup-composition.md)
- [Releases, Pages, and the market index](docs/releasing.md)
- [Delegation rules](docs/delegation-rules.md) and the [Codex subagent](docs/codex-subagent.md)
- Plugin notes: [Ponytail](docs/ponytail.md), [working principles](docs/principles.md),
  [RTK](docs/rtk.md), [Rust](docs/rust.md), [Serena](docs/serena.md), [OpenSpec](docs/openspec.md),
  [Loop guard](docs/loop-guard.md)
- Repository operating guide: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)

## Security

Installing a bundle runs its code with the permissions of the Harness process. Market entries pin an
exact git commit so the reviewed source and the running code are the same revision. Third-party
prompts and skills are vendored with provenance locks (`ponytail.lock.json`, `openspec.lock.json`)
that offline tests verify. The installer closes DeepSeek Harness while it writes the profile, saves a
manifest backup, and changes only the bundle selection and installed packages — never the profile's
own patch. This repository contains no credentials, sessions, or machine-specific paths.

`packages/plugin-openspec/assets/openspec/`, and the Codex subagent provider in
`packages/plugin-codex-subagent/`.

Requires Node.js `>=24.18.0 <25` and the pinned pnpm `11.28.5` ([install
pnpm](https://pnpm.io/installation)).

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check        # typecheck, lint, build, tests
pnpm validate     # full local gate, including generated-file and installer checks
pnpm dogfood      # Windows: verify install.ps1 against a copy of this machine's profile
```

Generated files are committed: the setup patch, `lib/` output, and `client.js` bundles are built
ahead of time so bundles install from git without an install-time build step. Run `pnpm gen` after
changing a composition fragment and `pnpm build` after changing TypeScript sources; CI rejects a
commit whose generated files do not match their sources.

## Documentation

- [Install, update, manual install](docs/install.md)
- [Plugin development](docs/plugins.md)
- [Setup composition and the generated bundle](docs/setup-composition.md)
- [Releases, Pages, and the market index](docs/releasing.md)
- [Delegation rules](docs/delegation-rules.md) and the [Codex subagent](docs/codex-subagent.md)
- Plugin notes: [Ponytail](docs/ponytail.md), [working principles](docs/principles.md),
  [RTK](docs/rtk.md), [Rust](docs/rust.md), [Serena](docs/serena.md), [OpenSpec](docs/openspec.md),
  [Loop guard](docs/loop-guard.md)
- Repository operating guide: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)

## Security

Installing a bundle runs its code with the permissions of the Harness process. Market entries pin an
exact git commit so the reviewed source and the running code are the same revision. Third-party
prompts and skills are vendored with provenance locks (`ponytail.lock.json`, `openspec.lock.json`)
that offline tests verify. The installer closes DeepSeek Harness while it writes the profile, saves a
manifest backup, and changes only the bundle selection and installed packages — never the profile's
own patch. This repository contains no credentials, sessions, or machine-specific paths.

`packages/plugin-codex-subagent/`.

## Development

Requires Node.js `>=24.18.0 <25` and the pinned pnpm `11.28.5` ([install
pnpm](https://pnpm.io/installation)).

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check        # typecheck, lint, build, tests
pnpm validate     # full local gate, including generated-file and installer checks
pnpm dogfood      # Windows: verify install.ps1 against a copy of this machine's profile
```

Generated files are committed: the setup patch, `lib/` output, and `client.js` bundles are built
ahead of time so bundles install from git without an install-time build step. Run `pnpm gen` after
changing a composition fragment and `pnpm build` after changing TypeScript sources; CI rejects a
commit whose generated files do not match their sources.

## Documentation

- [Install, update, manual install](docs/install.md)
- [Plugin development](docs/plugins.md)
- [Setup composition and the generated bundle](docs/setup-composition.md)
- [Releases, Pages, and the market index](docs/releasing.md)
- [Delegation rules](docs/delegation-rules.md) and the [Codex subagent](docs/codex-subagent.md)
- Plugin notes: [Ponytail](docs/ponytail.md), [working principles](docs/principles.md),
  [RTK](docs/rtk.md), [Rust](docs/rust.md), [Serena](docs/serena.md), [OpenSpec](docs/openspec.md),
  [Loop guard](docs/loop-guard.md)
- Repository operating guide: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)

## Security

Installing a bundle runs its code with the permissions of the Harness process. Market entries pin an
exact git commit so the reviewed source and the running code are the same revision. Third-party
prompts and skills are vendored with provenance locks (`ponytail.lock.json`, `openspec.lock.json`)
that offline tests verify. The installer closes DeepSeek Harness while it writes the profile, saves a
manifest backup, and changes only the bundle selection and installed packages — never the profile's
own patch. This repository contains no credentials, sessions, or machine-specific paths.
